name: Teaching robots to see and act from images
gist: Papers developing vision-language-action models that let robots understand images and photos to perform manipulation and navigation tasks—the core challenge is predicting what action to take from visual input alone.
explain: The most direct way to teach a robot is to show it images or videos and let it learn the pattern: 'when you see this scene, do this action.' This is vision-language-action learning. A robot sees an image of a table with blocks. It learns to recognize the scene and decide: 'I should grasp the red block' or 'I should move left.' The appeal is obvious—we teach humans the same way, by showing and demonstrating. But this turns out to be extremely hard in practice because the robot has to compress everything about a scene into one decision. The scene contains infinite visual details, but only a few of them matter for the task. Lighting changes, the camera angle shifts, the size of the object varies, yet the action should stay roughly the same. How does the robot learn which details to ignore and which to attend to?

The core difficulty is that predicting an action from a single image requires the robot to hallucinate what will happen next. If the robot grasps a soft object, it will deform differently than if it grasps a rigid one. If it places an object on a slanted surface, it might roll. The robot cannot 'see' this without reaching into the future. Traditional computer vision alone is not enough—the model has to develop an intuition for physics, the consequences of motion, and how the world will respond. Building this intuition only from images is like learning to drive a car from photographs.

Papers in this area use several approaches. Some train large neural networks (inspired by large language models) on many robot videos, teaching them to predict not just what the robot should do, but also to understand what is happening in the scene. Others combine visual learning with language—so a human can say 'pick up the small red cube' and the robot learns to translate language to action. Some add reasoning steps in between: the robot first understands the scene, then reasons about what to do, then predicts the action. The best results come from training on diverse, large-scale data—watching thousands of hours of robot demonstrations and learning the patterns.

papers.title: AutoFly: Vision-Language-Action Model for UAV Autonomous Navigation in the Wild
papers.contribution: Constructed a novel autonomous navigation dataset emphasizing continuous planning and obstacle avoidance; AutoFly achieves robust autonomous UAV navigation in real-world scenarios without detailed pre-specified instructions.

papers.title: Autonomous Play with Correspondence-Driven Trajectory Warping
papers.contribution: Tether performs many hours of autonomous real-world play, generating over 1000 expert-level trajectories that train policies competitive with those learned from human-collected demonstrations.

papers.title: Embodied-R1: Reinforced Embodied Reasoning for General Robotic Manipulation
papers.contribution: Achieves 56.2% zero-shot success on SIMPLEREnv and 87.5% on 8 real-world XArm tasks (62% improvement over baselines) with robust handling of visual disturbances.

papers.title: Human-Object Interaction via Automatically Designed VLM-Guided Motion Policy
papers.contribution: The framework outperforms existing methods in synthesizing natural human-like motions across simple single-task and complex multi-task scenarios involving static, dynamic, and articulated objects.

papers.title: Hybrid Training for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.contribution: HyT preserves performance improvements from reasoning without the inference time cost through hybrid training.

papers.title: Interleave-VLA: Enhancing Robot Manipulation with Image-Text Interleaved Instructions
papers.contribution: Improves out-of-domain generalization to unseen objects by 2x compared to text baselines and supports flexible task interfaces like hand-drawn sketches in zero-shot manner.

papers.title: MemoryVLA: Perceptual-Cognitive Memory in Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation
papers.contribution: Achieves 71.9%, 72.7%, 96.5%, and 41.2% success on SimplerEnv-Bridge, Fractal, LIBERO-5, and Mikasa-Robo respectively, outperforming baselines by up to 26%.

papers.title: OneTwoVLA: A Unified Vision-Language-Action Model with Adaptive Reasoning
papers.contribution: OneTwoVLA excels in long-horizon planning, error detection/recovery, human-robot interaction, and visual grounding, enabling complex manipulation tasks like making hotpot or mixing cocktails.

papers.title: RoboInter: A Holistic Intermediate Representation Suite Towards Robotic Manipulation
papers.contribution: Establishes foundation for advancing generalizable robotic learning; RoboInter-VQA benchmarks current VLMs on 28 embodied QA categories.

papers.title: Sim2Real VLA: Zero-Shot Generalization of Synthesized Skills to Realistic Manipulation
papers.contribution: Demonstrates seamless transfer to real-world manipulation across bimanual, dexterous, and long-horizon tasks with improved performance over prior VLA baselines.

papers.title: Towards Physically Executable 3D Gaussian for Embodied Navigation
papers.contribution: Demonstrates strong generalizability with 31% improvement on VLN-CE Unseen task; provides benchmark showing 3DGS data is harder to converge but exhibits superior generalization.

papers.title: TwinVLA: Data-Efficient Bimanual Manipulation with Twin Single-Arm Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.contribution: Outperforms comparably-sized monolithic models and narrows the gap to state-of-the-art approaches, establishing modular composition as data-efficient for high-performance bimanual manipulation.

papers.title: VLM4VLA: Revisiting Vision-Language-Models in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.contribution: Reveals that VLM general capabilities are poor predictors of VLA task performance, vision encoders are critical bottlenecks, and embodied task fine-tuning doesn't guarantee control improvements.

papers.title: WholeBodyVLA: Towards Unified Latent VLA for Whole-body Loco-manipulation Control
papers.contribution: WholeBodyVLA enables large-space humanoid loco-manipulation on AgiBot X2, outperforming prior baselines by 21.3% and demonstrating strong generalization across tasks.

papers.title: $AutoDrive\text{-}P^3$: Unified Chain of Perception–Prediction–Planning Thought via Reinforcement Fine-Tuning
papers.contribution: AutoDrive-P3 enables safer and more interpretable autonomous driving through coherent reasoning that progressively generates answers for perception, prediction, and planning.

papers.title: A Generalist Pair-wise Progress Critic Model for Vision-Language-Action Robots
papers.contribution: Specifically, we propose a scalable and generalizable pair-wise progress understanding approach that can predict the delta of task progress between two steps in a trajectory and generate correct actions to complete the task.

papers.title: AIR-VLA: Vision-Language-Action Systems for Aerial Manipulation
papers.contribution: Evaluates mainstream VLA models revealing capabilities and boundaries regarding UAV mobility, manipulator control, and high-level planning in aerial systems.

papers.title: Action-aware Dynamic Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
papers.contribution: ADP achieves 1.35x speed up on OpenVLA-OFT with 25.8% improvements in success rate across LIBERO and real-world manipulation scenarios.

papers.title: Actions as Language: Fine-Tuning VLMs into VLAs Without Catastrophic Forgetting
papers.contribution: Preserves VLM core capabilities across 800+ real-world robotics experiments while enabling zero-shot generalization to novel tasks requiring open-world semantic reasoning.

papers.title: Align-Then-stEer: Adapting the Vision-Language Action Models through Unified Latent Guidance
papers.contribution: Improves average multi-task success rate by up to 9.8% in simulation and achieves 32% success rate gain in real-world cross-embodiment manipulation.

papers.title: Any3D-VLA: Enhancing VLA Robustness via Diverse Point Clouds
papers.contribution: Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate Any3D-VLA improves performance and mitigates domain gap in robotic manipulation tasks.

papers.title: AutoDrive-R²: Incentivizing Reasoning and Self-Reflection Capacity for VLA Model in Autonomous Driving
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes and Waymo datasets with robust generalization and improved interpretability through reasoning and self-reflection.

papers.title: BEAR: Dissecting Embodied Abilities in Multimodal Language Models through Skill-level Evaluation and Diagnosis
papers.contribution: Discover that perceptual capabilities are major bottlenecks and models fail from unstable spatiotemporal modeling, achieving 17.5% relative improvement on embodied tasks.

papers.title: Can VLMs Diagnose and Recover from VLA Manipulation Faults?
papers.contribution: FaultEval reliably characterizes closed-loop diagnosis and repair; upper-bound analysis shows idealized feedback can improve success rates by 13% on LIBERO and 35% on real robots.

papers.title: Contrastive Representation Regularization for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.contribution: RS-CL substantially improves performance of state-of-the-art VLA models, achieving 69.7% on RoboCasa-Kitchen benchmark and boosting success rates from 45.0% to 58.3% on challenging real-robot manipulation tasks.

papers.title: Cortical Policy: A Dual-Stream View Transformer for Robotic Manipulation
papers.contribution: Cortical Policy substantially outperforms baselines on RLBench, COLOSSEUM, and real-world manipulation tasks with language-conditional control.

papers.title: Cross-Embodied Co-Design for Dexterous Hands
papers.contribution: Enables end-to-end pipeline from design to training to fabrication to deployment of a robotic hand in under 24 hours.

papers.title: DecoVer: A Decompose-and-Verify Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Embodied Task Planning with BC+
papers.contribution: Achieves 12.9% success rate gain over Gemini-3-Pro-Preview and 60.9% improvement over GPT-5.1 on logically complex test cases.

papers.title: Discrete Diffusion VLA: Bringing Discrete Diffusion to Action Decoding in Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.contribution: Achieves 96.4% avg success on LIBERO, 71.2% visual matching on SimplerEnv-Fractal, 54.2% on SimplerEnv-Bridge with superior vision-language capability retention in out-of-distribution tests.

papers.title: Discrete Diffusion for Reflective Vision-Language-Action Models in Autonomous Driving
papers.contribution: Demonstrates significant advantages in safety-critical trajectory generation on NAVSIM benchmark through iterative self-correction without gradient computation.

papers.title: Disentangled Robot Learning via Separate Forward and Inverse Dynamics Pretraining
papers.contribution: DeFI achieves state-of-the-art on CALVIN (4.51 average task length) and SimplerEnv (51.2% success), plus 81.3% success in real-world deployment.

papers.title: Dismantling the Illusion of Vision-Language-Action Models Competence via Explicit Distributional Shifts
papers.contribution: Reveals performance stratifications previously masked by standard metrics identifying perceptual instability and action binding as primary failure modes.

papers.title: DriveVLA-W0: World Models Amplify Data Scaling Law in Autonomous Driving
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms BEV and VLA baselines and amplifies data scaling law showing accelerated gains with larger training datasets.

papers.title: DriveWorld-VLA: Unified Latent-Space World Modeling with Vision–Language–Action for Autonomous Driving
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance with 91.3 PDMS on NAVSIMv1, 86.8 EPDMS on NAVSIMv2, and 0.16 3-second average collision rate on nuScenes.

papers.title: Dual-Stream Diffusion for World-Model Augmented Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 6% gains over state-of-the-art on RoboCasa and GR-1, with 10% improvement on real-world Franka tasks and strong transfer learning via action-free video pretraining.

papers.title: DyGRO-VLA: Cross-Task Scaling of Vision–Language–Action Models via Dynamic Grouped Residual Optimization
papers.contribution: Demonstrates consistent improvements over baselines on LIBERO and RoboTwin2 benchmarks and real-world tasks under multi-task training and distribution shift.

papers.title: DynVLA: Learning World Dynamics for Action Reasoning in Autonomous Driving
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms Textual CoT and Visual CoT methods on NAVSIM, Bench2Drive, and large-scale driving datasets, validating Dynamics CoT effectiveness.

papers.title: ECo-MoE: Embodiment-Conditioned Mixture of Experts Increases the Evolvability of Robots
papers.contribution: The modular framework preserves ancestral knowledge while allowing different body plans to activate different sensorimotor circuits, with pretrained expert policies pluggable to guide evolution.

papers.title: EVLP: Learning Unified Embodied Vision-Language Planner with Reinforced Supervised Fine-Tuning
papers.contribution: EVLP enables effective multimodal planning for long-horizon embodied tasks through coordinated language-visual modeling.

papers.title: EcoVLA: Environment-Aware Adaptive Pruning with Interleaved Inference Orchestration for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 1.60x speedup with 0.4% success-rate drop, and 2.18x speedup with 0.5% degradation when combined with token pruning; validated on real robots.

papers.title: Efficient Skill Grounding via Code Refactoring with Small Language Models
papers.contribution: Achieves best sLM-based Code-as-Policies performance matching LLM-based CaP across diverse robot embodiments in dynamic environments.

papers.title: Embodied Interpretability: Linking Causal Understanding to Generalization in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.contribution: NMR predicts generalization behavior across diverse manipulation tasks, and ISS yields more faithful explanations than existing interpretability methods, providing a diagnostic approach for identifying causal misalignment in embodied policies.

papers.title: Embodied Navigation Foundation Model
papers.contribution: Extensive evaluations on seven public benchmarks demonstrate that our model achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive performance across different navigation tasks and embodiments without requir

papers.title: Embodied-DETR: End-to-End Temporal 3D Object Detection in Egocentric Views
papers.contribution: Embodied-DETR achieves superior accuracy and temporal consistency compared to existing methods on the new Embodied-Det benchmark, which evaluates detection accuracy, temporal stability, and consistency.

papers.title: Endowing GPT-4 with a Humanoid Body: Building the Bridge Between Off-the-Shelf VLMs and the Physical World
papers.contribution: BiBo achieves 90.2% task success rate and improves text-guided motion precision by 16.3% over prior methods.

papers.title: EnsembleVLA: Ensemble Learning for Vision-Language Action Models
papers.contribution: Achieves competitive performance across various tasks in simulated and real-world environments by seamlessly aggregating multiple pre-trained policies into stronger ensemble policies.

papers.title: FASTer: Toward Powerful and Efficient Autoregressive Vision–Language–Action Models with Learnable Action Tokenizer and Block-wise Decoding
papers.contribution: Surpasses previous state-of-the-art VLA models in both inference speed and task performance with superior reconstruction quality and strong cross-task and cross-embodiment generalization.

papers.title: FOCA: Future-Oriented Conditioning for Data-Efficient Vision-Language-Action Adaptation
papers.contribution: Achieves 95.7% success with 20 demonstrations on LIBERO, 7-12% improvement on RoboCasa, and up to 26% gains on real robots.

papers.title: From Abstraction to Instantiation: Learning Behavioral Representation for Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.contribution: Achieves SOTA on RoboTwin 2.0 (58%), LIBERO (98%), CALVIN (4.36); sim-to-real transfer matches OpenVLA-OFT with only 50% of data.

papers.title: From Noise to Intent: Anchoring Generative VLA Policies with Residual Bridges
papers.contribution: Achieves competitive performance with strong robustness to language and embodiment perturbations, faster convergence than generative baselines, and strong real-world robot performance.

papers.title: From Pixels to Tokens: A Systematic Study of Latent Action Supervision for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.contribution: Finally, our experiments offer initial insights into the benefits of latent action supervision in mixed-data, suggesting a promising direction for VLA training

papers.title: From Seeing to Doing: Bridging Reasoning and Decision for Robotic Manipulation
papers.contribution: Achieves 40.6% success rate in SimplerEnv and 72% in real-world tasks, outperforming strongest baseline by 30% through improved spatial reasoning.

papers.title: From Spatial to Actions: Grounding Vision-Language-Action Model in Spatial Foundation Priors
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on three simulation benchmarks and eleven real-world tasks, remaining robust under clutter, spatial conditioning, and scale variations.

papers.title: Generalizable Coarse-to-Fine Robot Manipulation via Language-Aligned 3D Keypoints
papers.contribution: On GemBench, CLAP achieves 12% higher success rate than SOTA using only 1/5 of training trajectories, and real-world experiments show policies trained on 10 demonstrations generalize to novel instructions and environments.

papers.title: HALO: A Unified Vision-Language-Action Model for Embodied Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
papers.contribution: Surpasses baseline on RoboTwin by 25.9%; shows strong generalization under aggressive environment randomization.

papers.title: HAMLET: Switch Your Vision-Language-Action Model into a History-Aware Policy
papers.contribution: On GR00T N1.5 baseline, achieves 76.4% success on history-dependent tasks (47.2% improvement), pushes RoboCasa from 64.1% to 66.4%, and LIBERO from 95.6% to 97.7%.

papers.title: HiMe: Hierarchical Embodied Memory for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Control
papers.contribution: Significantly improves long-horizon task success rates while balancing real-time execution and deliberative planning, with the ability to self-correct internal knowledge based on human preferences.

papers.title: LAGEA: Language Guided Embodied Agents for Robotic Manipulation
papers.contribution: Improves average success by 9.0% on random goals, 5.3% on fixed goals, and 17% on fetch tasks on Meta-World benchmarks.

papers.title: LARA: Latent Action Representation Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.contribution: Achieves approximately 10% improvement on simulation benchmarks, ~5% on mixed, and ~15% on real-world manipulation tasks compared to baselines, with versatility across pre-training and post-training enhancement scenarios.

papers.title: LaST$_{0}$: Latent Spatio-Temporal Chain-of-Thought for Robotic Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.contribution: Improves mean performance across 10 real-world tasks spanning tabletop, mobile, and dexterous manipulation while reducing inference latency.

papers.title: Latent Reasoning VLA: Latent Thinking and Prediction for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.contribution: Outperforms state-of-the-art VLA methods while achieving up to 90% reduction in inference latency compared to explicit CoT-based VLA approaches.

papers.title: Learning to Move Before Learning to Do: Task-Agnostic pretraining for VLAs
papers.contribution: Matches models trained on 1M+ trajectories using orders of magnitude less labeled data; achieves 10% absolute gain over behavior cloning; surpasses internet-scale baselines under visual distribution shifts.

papers.title: Lifelong Embodied Navigation Learning
papers.contribution: Superior lifelong embodied navigation learning maintaining reasoning quality while acquiring new skills across diverse scenes and instruction styles.

papers.title: ManipEvalAgent: Promptable and Efficient Evaluation Framework for Robotic Manipulation Policies
papers.contribution: ManipEvalAgent significantly reduces evaluation time compared to traditional simulation benchmarks while reaching comparable conclusions.

papers.title: MomaGraph: State-Aware Unified Scene Graphs with Vision-Language Models for Embodied Task Planning
papers.contribution: Achieves 71.6% accuracy on MomaGraph-Bench (+11.4% over best baseline) for task-oriented scene graph prediction and generalizes across public benchmarks.

papers.title: Motion Dynamics Learning for Few-Shot Embodied Adaptation
papers.contribution: DynVLA outperforms SOTA by 15.8% in average success rate with around 20 demonstrations on 13 real-world manipulation tasks.

papers.title: Natural Language PDDL (NL-PDDL) for Open-world Goal-oriented Commonsense Regression Planning in Embodied AI
papers.contribution: Addresses open-world planning without exhaustive grounding, achieving complexity independent of state-action space sizes.

papers.title: NeurVLA: Unleashing Failure-Handling Capability of Vision-Language-Action Models via Neural-Symbolic Reasoning
papers.contribution: Achieves strong performance and robust generalization across diverse embodied tasks.

papers.title: Neural Implicit Action Fields: From Discrete Waypoints to Continuous Functions for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.contribution: Achieves strong results on CALVIN and LIBERO, with real-world experiments confirming support for stable impedance control bridging policy-side action generation and execution-side smooth control.

papers.title: OmniEVA: Embodied Versatile Planner via Task-Adaptive 3D-Grounded and Embodiment-aware Reasoning
papers.contribution: OmniEVA achieves state-of-the-art on 7 of 8 embodied reasoning benchmarks and excels in object navigation and mobile manipulation.

papers.title: On Robustness of Vision-Language-Action Model against Multi-Modal Perturbations
papers.contribution: RobustVLA achieves 12.6% gains over baselines on the pi_0 backbone and 10.4% on OpenVLA across 17 perturbations with 50.6x faster inference than visual-robust methods.

papers.title: PACT: Self-Evolving Physical Safety Alignment for Diffusion Policies in Embodied Manipulation
papers.contribution: Reduces safety violations by 31.0% on average while improving task success by 30.7% on simulated and real-world embodied manipulation benchmarks.

papers.title: PixelVLA: Advancing Pixel-level Understanding in Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.contribution: Improves manipulation success rates by 10.1-28.7% over OpenVLA while requiring only 1.5% of its pretraining cost.

papers.title: Pretrained Vision-Language-Action Models are Surprisingly Resistant to Forgetting in Continual Learning
papers.contribution: Demonstrates large pretraining fundamentally changes continual learning dynamics, enabling simple replay to maintain strong forward learning with minimal forgetting.

papers.title: RA-VLA: Retrieval-Augmented VLA for Test-Time Adaptation
papers.contribution: Achieves superior success rates and computational efficiency on LIBERO benchmark and real UR5e environment; provides robust framework for training-free robotic adaptation.

papers.title: RDT2: Exploring the Scaling Limit of UMI Data Towards Zero-Shot Cross-Embodiment Generalization
papers.contribution: Zero-shot generalizes to unseen objects, scenes, instructions, and robotic platforms while outperforming baselines on dexterous and dynamic tasks.

papers.title: REI-Bench: Can Embodied Agents Understand Vague Human Instructions in Task Planning?
papers.contribution: The approach achieves state-of-the-art performance and demonstrates that vagueness in referring expressions can cause success rate drops up to 36.9%.

papers.title: ReCogDrive: A Reinforced Cognitive Framework for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art on NAVSIM and Bench2Drive benchmarks with improved scene comprehension and safety.

papers.title: Reasoning-VLA: An Efficient and Spatial-Guided General Vision-Language-Action Reasoning Model for Autonomous Driving
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance with strong generalization capability and excellent inference speed via parallel decoding across multiple driving benchmarks.

papers.title: Reflex: Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Control through Streaming Inference
papers.contribution: Achieves 2.58x inference speedup and 50Hz stable streaming, reducing reaction latency by up to 54% on LIBERO and Kinetix benchmarks without performance degradation.

papers.title: Rethinking Video Generation Model for the Embodied World
papers.contribution: Provides evaluation lens identifying deficiencies and establishes foundation for training via largest open-source robotic video dataset; finetuning on RoVid-X yields consistent performance gains.

papers.title: RoboMME: Benchmarking and Understanding Memory for Robotic Generalist Policies
papers.contribution: Shows memory representation effectiveness is highly task-dependent with each design offering distinct advantages across different manipulation scenarios.

papers.title: RoboOmni: Actions Are Just Another Modality for Vision-Language Models
papers.contribution: RoboOmni establishes state-of-the-art performance on CALVIN and SimplerEnv, achieving 94.4% average success rate with FAST tokenizer and 27x inference speedup.

papers.title: SCALE: Self-uncertainty Conditioned Adaptive Looking and Execution for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.contribution: Improves state-of-the-art VLAs on simulated and real-world benchmarks, outperforming existing test-time scaling while maintaining single-pass efficiency.

papers.title: SCOPE: Evolving Symbolic World for Planning in Open-Ended Environments
papers.contribution: SCOPE significantly improves symbolic world completeness, plan success rate under environment perturbations, and cross-task grounding across diverse embodied scenarios.

papers.title: STEP: Warm-Started Visuomotor Policies with Spatiotemporal Consistency Prediction
papers.contribution: With 2 steps, STEP achieves 21.6% and 27.5% higher success rate than BRIDGER and DDIM on RoboMimic and real-world tasks respectively, with theoretical analysis ensuring convergence.

papers.title: SafeLab: An Interactive High-Fidelity Benchmark for Embodied Safety in Scientific Robotics
papers.contribution: SafeLab reveals unsafe-but-successful trajectories and bounded residual RL improves simulated Safe Success Rate by up to 43 percentage points; physical replays show 86% agreement between simulation and observed safety.

papers.title: Sample from What You See: Visuomotor Policy Learning via Diffusion Bridge with Observation-Embedded Stochastic Differential Equation
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms state-of-the-art generative policies across 52 simulation tasks and 5 real-world robotic tasks.

papers.title: Scaling by Diversified Experience for Vision-Language-Action Models

papers.title: Scaling up Memory for Robotic Control via Experience Retrieval

papers.title: See What Matters: Differentiable Grid Sample Pruning for Generalizable Vision-Language-Action Model

papers.title: Seeing Realism from Simulation: Efficient Video Transfer for Vision-Language-Action Data Augmentation
papers.contribution: Method improves RDT-1B by 8% on Robotwin 2.0 and boosts π_0 by 5.1% on LIBERO-Plus, demonstrating consistent improvements across robotic platforms.

papers.title: Self-Improving Loops for Visual Robotic Planning
papers.contribution: Demonstrates continuous performance improvements over multiple iterations on novel MetaWorld tasks and real robot manipulation with robustness to poor initial demonstrations.

papers.title: Sentinel-VLA: A Metacognitive VLA Model with Active Status Monitoring for Dynamic Reasoning and Error Recovery
papers.contribution: Boosts task success rate by over 30% compared to SOTA model PI0, with all training data (2.6 million transitions across 44 tasks) automatically generated via a designed pipeline.

papers.title: SimpleVLA-RL: Scaling VLA Training via Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves 99% of SoTA performance on LIBERO and 80% relative improvement on RoboTwin 1.0&2.0, surpassing SFT in real-world tasks and reducing dependence on large-scale data.

papers.title: Spatial Forcing: Implicit Spatial Representation Alignment for Vision-language-action Model
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art surpassing both 2D/3D baselines, accelerates training 3.8x, improves data efficiency across robotic tasks.

papers.title: Spatial Memory for Out-of-Vision Manipulation in Vision-Language-Action
papers.contribution: Improves task success on out-of-vision manipulation tasks with faster target localization and near one-shot grasping under partial observability.

papers.title: Spatially Guided Training for Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.contribution: SP-VLA achieves 66.1→84.6 on Google Robot and 54.7→73.2 on WidowX with improved generalization to unseen objects and robustness to real-world perturbations.

papers.title: SpecPrune-VLA: Accelerating Vision-Language-Action Models via Action-Aware Self-Speculative Pruning
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 1.57x speedup in LIBERO simulation and 1.70x on real-world tasks with negligible success rate degradation by adapting pruning to coarse or fine-grained actions.

papers.title: Speedup Patch: Learning a Plug-and-Play Policy to Accelerate Embodied Manipulation
papers.contribution: In this paper, we propose **S**peed**u**p **P**atch (**SuP**), a lightweight, policy-agnostic framework that enables **plug-and-play acceleration** using solely offline data.

papers.title: SpikeVLA: Vision-Language-Action Models with Spiking Neural Networks
papers.contribution: Significantly reduce energy consumption and computational overhead while maintaining competitive performance on multimodal interaction and robotic control tasks.

papers.contribution: TIC-VLA consistently outperforms prior VLA models while maintaining robust real-time control under multi-second reasoning latency in both simulation and real robots.

papers.title: Unifying Diffusion and Autoregression for Generalizable Vision-Language-Action Model
